title: feature: how to build xDrip APK from multiple pull requests and with custom updater
body:
**Motivation:** We are xDrip+Libre2 and 2 followers. I am capable to do some minor improvements to xDrip and work also on translation. I like work that is done in some pull requests which are not merged to master and for sure need some testing. I know other families that could also be interested in testing, but don't have the knowledge to build own xDrip version.

**Idea for solution:**
- have a build script that uses latest Nightly maintained by @jamorham as base and mixes other branches into it
- sign APK with custom certificate so it is installable in same way as Nightly
- have custom updater to automaticaly distribute new versions of this custom xDrip build to people who trust it

**Solution implementation:**
- [x] add configurable updater to xDrip code base
- [x] disable the current xDrip updater if custom updater is included
- [x] improve generated version number to work with multiple builds in the same day
- [x] create example updater configuration
- [x] create example build script
- [x] add option to build APK based on nightly instead from master
- [x] update the build script to build release APK from command like (with `gradlew`)
- [ ] create script to deploy release APK and to update the updater configuration
- [ ] find out how to use Github hooks to build this release APK when any of the included pull requests receive new commit
- [ ] allow to customize where to send the crash reports
- [x] publish own APK with features I am interested in as proof of concept

comments.body:
Current state of implementation:

* custom updater - #1038, builds on https://github.com/javiersantos/AppUpdater
* version number change - #1038, change from `yyyy.MM.dd` to `yy.MMdd.HHmmss`
* update configuration for my APK - https://gist.github.com/k2s/aa7928197d8ea508135bc20bb9bdd664
* example build script - https://gist.github.com/k2s/2feac7fb5ca8319a8bd198a731015a81
* my personal APK build for testing of new features - http://bit.do/xdrip-k2s

Current show stoppers:

* build with latest Gradle doesn't work - #1012, I have to build APK manually in Android Studio
* what is @jamorham opinion on this
#1160 build APK signed with data in `signing.properties` by calling `./gradlew :xdripupdater:assembleRelease` so no manual Android Studio invokation is neede
I'm not really sure whether we should include this into the public version. IMHO, a good documentation of the basic command chain should be enough.

This is not an xDrip bug or feature request.  It seems to be documentation, which an xDrip developer may benefit from.  I don't even think a regular xDrip user would need this info.  I don't mean there is no value.  But, I would like it to be were it belongs.
I am closing this and we can have it added to documentation.
